channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
item.description: In controlled offline evaluations, HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline while reducing estimated workflow cost. Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot. (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Airbnb Cuts Authentication Code by 60% with Server Driven Architecture
item.description: Airbnb redesigned its authentication architecture around server driven flows and policy based challenge selection. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Blume: Zero-Config Docs Framework That Turns a Markdown Folder into an AI-Ready Website
item.description: Blume is an open-source documentation framework that converts Markdown into a complete documentation site. Built with Astro and Vite, it requires only Node.js and a single Markdown file for setup. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: A preview of the future Intel Architecture documentation
item.description: This website contains a preview of how Intel intends to document and present the Intel® Architecture in the future. Our goal is a specification that is more accurate and accessible. (1 source: lobsters)
